474e5456b3eef582a780.en: Newtalk News A suspected terrorist plot recently erupted near a Royal Air Force base in western England used by U.S. forces to conduct military operations against Iran. British police arrested five men on the 27th, initially detained on suspicion of violating the Explosives Act, and then further arrested them on suspicion of preparing to launch a terrorist attack. Police have been alerted to three suspected white vans heading towards RAF Fairford in western England. According to Reuters, the incident occurred in the early hours of the morning on the 27th local time. British counter-terrorism police said they had been alerted to the presence of three suspicious vehicles and suspicious persons near the base at about 12:45 a.m. Armed police arrived at the scene and arrested five men in the Wilford area near the base.

0d9406e35b57d42e4e50.en: Kaohsiung City Police Department, Okayama Branch received a public report on the 29th, indicating that a body was found on the farm road in Qiaotou District. After inspection, the body was in a dry state, temporarily unable to identify the appearance, there were no signs of fighting at the scene, and the intervention of external forces was initially excluded. The whole case will be reported to the prosecutor of Qiaotou District Prosecutor's Office for examination in accordance with the law. (Provided by the Gangshan Branch of the Kaohsiung Municipal Police Department) Central News Agency reporter Zhang Zhenzhen September 29, 115 Newtalk News (Central News Agency reporter Zhang Zhenzhen, Kaohsiung 29th) People smelled a strange odor on the farm road through Kaohsiung Qiaotou District today, checked and reported to the police. After the police arrived and inspected, the body was in a dry state and could not be identified. The police initially excluded external intervention, and will report to the prosecutor for examination to clarify the cause of death.
